paragraphs: The Discovery TDV8 uses the 4.4-litre V8 diesel engine, fitted across the D3 and D4 generations from 2004 to 2016. It shares its fundamental architecture with the TDV6/SDV6 family, with the same timing chain, injector seal, and EGR components — just in a V8 configuration with four extra cylinders. The TDV8 was positioned as the range-topping diesel option during this era, offering more power and torque than its V6 stablemates. If you have a Discovery with the TDV8 badge, the engine's known wear patterns are well understood at this point — and we know exactly what to address during a rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV8 engines for every Discovery TDV8 on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the Discovery TDV8 spans two generations (D3 and D4) with running changes between them, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming parts are interchangeable across all years — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact year and generation (D3/L319 or D4/L319 facelift) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

points.text: Your exact engine code (TDV8) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
